doc: P2.21 prompt-lab v2 run plan. One llama-server launch per exercise: the steering dose is a launch flag (docs/06 §4), never a per-request parameter. `scheduled` runs each stage's scripted sets at its docs/02 §9 base dose (the phase-exit gate); `sweep` runs the same 18-case probe set at doses 0, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10 and 12 — dose 4 and 5 were added in round 2 so the dose-4→6 step has a same-set controlled pair instead of a cross-set juxtaposition (review DES-2); `offered` measures the announced-action turn the Director will run once MetaDirector offers (docs/05): every case carries a non-empty `offered_actions` (so the Turn schema's `action` enum is wider than ['none'], review CODE-5) and its docs/05 §2 OPPORTUNITY lines in the events layer, so the model is told why each action is available (review DES-r2-1). The harness owns its own server on port 8095 so it never fights the shared dev server on 8089 (P2.18 owns that one); the URL is recorded in results meta. `fallback` re-runs the stage-4/5 sets at dose-2 (docs/02 §7's retry offset) as the control that separates prompt quality from dose damage: same prompts, lower malice.
